description: An oil painting of about a dozen men in dark mid-century suits and ties gathered around a polished wooden conference table in a dim, wood-panelled room lit by one hanging lamp. Several lean over a large map spread on the table among papers, pens and water glasses; one in the foreground gestures with an open hand, another rests his chin on his fist. A faded world map hangs on the back wall. There is no legible text, border, frame or violence; the painting runs edge to edge with only a small corner sparkle mark.
